title: 第1章 邪恶空间第2章 武馆试炼
content_zh:
叶宇轩手中紧握着一张工商银行的借记卡，看着周围熟悉的景物，却茫然若失的走在大街上！
街道上热闹非凡，熙熙攘攘的人群在交谈着，喧嚣着，可是叶宇轩心中却一片冰冷！
当兵五年，就在退伍的前两天，平时难得一见的首长把自己叫进了他的办公室，在无数士兵羡慕的眼光中，叶宇轩昂首阔步的走了进去，就在他的朋友，兄弟认为他要获得什么大馅饼的时候。
站在首长面前的宇轩，听完首长那庄重的话语，突然觉得眼前一黑，双腿一软差点跌倒在地。这一刻，叶宇轩再也无法控制住自己的情绪，失态的吼叫起来。
没有人知道这个声音持续了多久，只不过在那些士兵跑完五公里的路程之后，还没有停止。时间分分秒秒的流逝，直到他的声音嘶哑，接着是死沉的静寂，叶宇轩静静的站着一动不动，双眼无神，如果不是能够听见他均匀的呼吸，真以为他是一座雕像。
时间匆匆而过，原本明亮的天空，已经变的漆黑一片。叶宇轩依旧默默的站在，只是脸颊两边不知何时流下两行清泪。
又不知过了多久，坐在椅子上静静的看着宇轩的首长忽然站了起来。飞速奔跑出去，对着两个守卫道；“快，快给我去喊军医。”
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
缓缓的睁开双眼，五个和自己最要好的战友，兄弟，都静静的躺在自己的床边熟睡。看到他们，宇轩原本冰冷的心，稍稍热乎了一些。
身体微微一动，五个反应有素的老兵立即有所察觉，从睡梦中惊醒，条件反射的站立起来。摆出一副防守姿势。待看到醒来的叶宇轩，都轻轻的送了一口气。
一个看上去成熟稳重的男人，走到叶宇轩面前，轻轻的拍了拍他的肩膀道：“老三啊，你的事情我们都知道了。大哥跟你说挺住，你要车票，还有便当，给你在路上吃。”说完，将包裹递给他，缓缓的走到一旁。
看着眼前的兄弟，宇轩感到自己的鼻子一酸，眼眶中好像有什么在打转，要落下来。强忍住这股冲动，掀开床单，站了起来。对着身前的5为兄弟缓缓的弯腰鞠了一躬。拿起车票与便当，和已经帮助自己收拾好的行李，快步的走出了房间，头也不回的向着前方使去。
昨天一个凄凉的早晨，叶宇轩抱着最后一丝的期望来到家门前，拿出寄存在自己怀中五年之久的钥匙推门而入。映入眼帘的是布满了蜘蛛网，没有丝毫人烟气息的大厅。
看着眼前的情景，那在炎热的太阳下面，一动不动的站立几个小时的双脚，突然一软。叶宇轩就在大理石的地板上跪了下来。那军人：“流血，流汗，不流泪的话语。”已经被他忘到了九霄云外，浑身颤抖的哭泣着。伤心，痛苦，充实着他的灵魂，但此时他还没有绝望，好抱着一丝侥幸的心里。毕竟没有事实可以证明自己的父母已经不在了。
突然，视力一直特别好的宇轩，在地上发现了一章布满灰尘的白纸，。跪趴着来到白纸旁边，捡起地上的白纸，弹掉上面的灰尘一看。身体素质特好的叶宇轩，突然头脑一昏，两眼一黑，倒在了地板上。
不知过了多久，幽幽醒来望着空洞黑暗的房顶，叶宇轩愤怒的大吼着：“可恶！可恶！为什么，！贼老天，你为什么怎么残忍，为什么这样对我……”
发泄完了的叶宇轩，连怒火都消失了，有的只是双眼中的死寂与绝望。
第二天早晨，他离开了伤心的家，拿着父母留给自己唯一的银行卡和现金，叶宇轩漫无目的的走上的大街。
生无可恋的他，实在不知道这个世界还有些什么是值得他活着。两个最亲最爱的人突然离自己而去，对叶宇轩的打击实在太大。
思考了好久，最终还是认为死亡是他唯一的选择，当年特爱古装片的他，经常看到那些死囚在死亡之前会吃一顿好的，做一个饱死鬼，满足的死掉。虽然他不相信这些，但是也觉得在死之前，应该最后享受一次人生。

带着这个目的，宇轩跑到了扬城四星级大酒店－新世纪，满足的饱餐了一顿鱼翅燕窝粥，打着饱嗝走向了一个建筑工地的高台。
站在那里，感受着周围清爽的空气，叶宇轩仔仔细细的看了最后一眼美丽的家乡，美丽的扬城，缓缓闭眼，双脚微微抬起。
刚欲跳下，耳边忽然响起一个充满诱惑的声音：“你想实现自己的愿望吗？你想要有可以抗衡天地的实力吗？你对这个不公平的世界感到愤怒吗？你想获得金钱与权势吗？只要你说声确定，那么你就能获得一个机会！”
“真是无聊，以为我是三岁小孩，会相信你这种不着边际的话。”叶宇轩心中默默的想着，同时带着深深的不屑与鄙夷。
双脚抬得更高了，几乎与地面分离，只有脚尖还有一丝着地。就在这时，叶宇轩脑中一丝灵光闪过，隐隐感觉到了哪里有些不对劲。
对了，自己现在可是在高楼之顶，而且是这个时候，应该没有人会来此地，怎么会有人的声音传入自己的耳中。好奇心的驱使下，身体立即向后一倾，脚后跟着地。
猛然睁开双眼，扫视四周，没有任何踪影，以为自己产生幻觉的叶宇轩刚刚准备再次跳楼。那道声音又传了出来。
“请选择：确定与取消。”
“确定，”看着四周确实无人，想知道到底是什么在装神弄鬼，叶宇轩带着无比的好奇，大声喊道。
突然，叶宇轩就昏迷了过去，当他再次醒来的时候已经出现在一个广阔的房间内，在他的面前站着一名有着黑色羽翼，黑发银瞳，头上长着两只山羊角，十分向书中所记载的恶魔形象的男子笑吟吟的看着他。
欢迎来到邪恶空间，在这里你能获得一切你想要的东西，只要你能完成了我们的任务，并且能一直活下去！我是解说员7654321号，你的疑问在权限范围之内的我都能帮你解答！”解说员7654321号和蔼的笑着说道。
看着这明显不是和自己相同种族的生物，叶宇轩先是一惊，然后慢慢的平静下来，因为对一个生无可恋的人来说，已经没有什么能够令他畏惧害怕了。
沉默了一下，叶宇轩看着那解说员7654321号问道，“我想知道如果我要让我的父母复活该如何去做。
解说员7654321号看到这个人类处变不惊的反应，微微有些惊奇的问道，“看到我，你不吃惊、害怕吗？”
“吃惊，可是对我这种连死亡都不害怕的人来说，又有什么能够使我害怕呢！”叶宇轩淡淡的说道。
复活，是可以的，但这可是一个高等愿望，以你现在的权限还无法做到。如果你想知道你父母骨灰的消息，加入我们，我现在就可以告诉你。解说员7654321号双眼透露着狡猾的目光，说道。
“我加入。”听到骨灰二字，叶宇轩的眼睛再次一暗，随后一亮，皱眉思考了一下，缓缓道。
解说员突然跪了下来，对着天空中无尽的黑暗道：“撒旦大人，请您降下魔光。帮助我们的新成员进行洗礼。
一道漆黑的光芒从那无尽的黑暗中射出，直没入凌叶宇轩的眉心，无数的信息在他脑海中响起：
根据天地规则，正邪空间建立。

“以下是邪恶空间的基本规则。”选中者将随即进入单机游戏世界或者网络游戏世界。
获得从属戒指的选中者，将可以在现实世界或者游戏世界中，随即拉取5~20个具有智慧的生物进入邪恶空间的权利。
强行拉取的被选者，实力必须在选中者之下。另外被选者必须进入十次空间，完成其中任务或者拿到100万点积分，方可获得一个愿望，并回归原来世界。只有选中者在进入空间，并完成一次任务之后可以将自己拉进来的智慧生物带出邪恶空间！
当选中者进行空间任务之时，所有被选者也必须进入邪恶空间，否则被抹杀。任何人不得在现实世界透露本空间的信息，否则被抹杀！”
选中者必须在邪恶空间规定的时间内履行并完成任务，另外每次进入的空间不定，随即选择。
“完成10次空间任务或者交纳100万点积分后无论是选中者还是被选者都可以实现一个愿望！并且完全可以脱离本空间，并自由的使用从空间中获得的能力！”
“在未完成10次空间任务或者交纳100万点积分之前，在现实世界中使用从本空间获得的能力必须保证没有任何人知道。如果有人知道，在特定的时间没有将该人消灭，则该选者将被抹杀！”
“是否希望成为选中者！选着：是。之后将经历选中者淘汰任务！经历的世界是游戏世界中的热血传奇世界！选着否，将会被消除记忆之后送还现实世界！
提示！本空间危险重重同死神差肩而过与魔鬼跳舞，但总会有一丝生机，请慎重选择加入！当你成为选中者之后，并完成任务。可以得知父母骨灰的消息，并能够获得现实中所需要的一定的金钱数量。
叶宇轩没有丝毫的迟疑，选择了确定。
选中者（假），编号666666，进行身体扫描，力量15【10】，敏捷12【10】，精神8【10】，体力13【10】，括号内是一般30岁成年男子拥有的素质。
“是否改变自己的形象！美化1%——100%！丑化1%——100%，相貌完全改变，人种显示白人、黄人、黑人，性别更改男或者女！请选择！”
“相貌完全更改！人种显示黄人，性别男！”
“初始化开始！初次进入空间，空间难度等级D，游戏者强化200%！痛觉削弱60%！离进入热血传奇世界还有20秒！
此世界是一个杀戮的世界。杀死和自己一样的选中者（假）可获得对方的装备，积分，道具。
试炼开始：一阵晕眩向叶宇轩袭来，顿时他陷入了无尽的黑暗
content_en:
Ye Yuxuan held an ICBC debit card tightly in his hand, looking at the familiar scenery around him, but walking on the street in a daze!
The streets were bustling with people talking and making noise, but Ye Yuxuan's heart felt cold!
After five years in the army, just two days before he was discharged, the leader, whom he rarely saw, called him into his office. In the envious eyes of countless soldiers, Ye Yuxuan strode in, just when his friends and brothers thought he was going to get some big pie.
Yuxuan, who was standing in front of the chief, suddenly felt his eyes go dark after listening to the chief's solemn words. His legs went weak and he almost fell to the ground. At this moment, Ye Yuxuan could no longer control his emotions and roared uncontrollably.
No one knows how long the sound lasted, but it didn't stop even after the soldiers completed the five-kilometer journey. Time passed by, until his voice became hoarse, and then there was dead silence. Ye Yuxuan stood quietly, motionless, his eyes dull. If he could not hear his even breathing, he would have thought he was a statue.
Time flies by, and the originally bright sky has turned pitch black. Ye Yuxuan still stood silently, but two lines of clear tears fell from both sides of his cheeks at some point.
I don't know how much time passed, but the leader who was sitting on the chair and watching Yuxuan quietly suddenly stood up. He ran out quickly and said to the two guards, "Quick, call me the military doctor."
--------------------------------------------------------- of
Slowly opening his eyes, he saw that his five best comrades and brothers were all lying quietly beside his bed, sleeping soundly. Seeing them, Yuxuan's originally cold heart warmed up a little.
The body moved slightly, and the five well-reacted veterans immediately noticed it, woke up from their sleep, and stood up reflexively. Get into a defensive stance. When they saw Ye Yuxuan waking up, they all breathed a sigh of relief.
A man who looked mature and steady walked up to Ye Yuxuan, patted him on the shoulder gently and said, "Third brother, we all know about you. Big brother told you to hold on, you want a ticket and a lunch box for you to eat on the way." After saying that, he handed the package to him and walked slowly aside.
Looking at the brother in front of him, Yuxuan felt his nose was sore, and something seemed to be spinning in his eyes, about to fall down. Resisting the urge, he lifted the sheets and stood up. He slowly bent down and bowed to the five brothers in front of him. Picking up the ticket, lunch, and the luggage that had been packed for him, he quickly walked out of the room and headed forward without looking back.
On a desolate morning yesterday, Ye Yuxuan came to the door of his house with his last hope, took out the key that had been stored in his arms for five years and pushed the door open. What came into view was a hall covered with spider webs and without the slightest trace of human habitation.
Looking at the scene in front of me, the feet that had stood motionless for several hours under the hot sun suddenly became weak. Ye Yuxuan knelt down on the marble floor. The soldier's words: "Blood, sweat, no tears." He had forgotten all about it, and he was trembling and crying. Sadness and pain filled his soul, but at this time he was not desperate yet, so he could hold on to a trace of luck. After all, there is no fact to prove that his parents are no longer alive.
Suddenly, Yuxuan, who had always had particularly good eyesight, found a dusty white paper on the ground. Kneel down and come to the white paper, pick up the white paper on the ground, flick the dust off and take a look. Ye Yuxuan, who was in excellent physical condition, suddenly became dizzy, his eyes darkened, and he fell to the floor.
After an unknown amount of time, Youyou woke up and looked at the empty and dark roof. Ye Yuxuan yelled angrily: "Damn it! Damn it!"evil! Why,! God, why are you so cruel, why are you treating me like this..."
After venting his anger, Ye Yuxuan's anger disappeared, leaving only the silence and despair in his eyes.
The next morning, he left his sad home. Taking the only bank card and cash left by his parents, Ye Yuxuan walked aimlessly onto the street.
He is hopeless and doesn't know what else in this world is worth living for. The two closest and dearest people suddenly left him, which was a huge blow to Ye Yuxuan.
After thinking about it for a long time, he finally decided that death was his only option. He loved period films back then and often saw those on death row eating a good meal before death, becoming a satiated ghost and dying contentedly. Although he didn't believe this, he felt that he should enjoy life one last time before dying.
With this purpose in mind, Yuxuan ran to the New Century, a four-star hotel in Yangcheng. He had a satisfying meal of shark's fin and bird's nest porridge, and burped as he walked to the high platform of a construction site.
Standing there, feeling the refreshing air around him, Ye Yuxuan carefully took one last look at his beautiful hometown, beautiful Yangcheng, slowly closed his eyes and raised his feet slightly.
Just as he was about to jump down, a seductive voice suddenly sounded in his ears: "Do you want to realize your wish?你想要有可以抗衡天地的实力吗？你对这个不公平的世界感到愤怒吗？你想获得金钱与权势吗？ As long as you say yes, you will get a chance! "
“It’s so boring, I thought I was a three-year-old kid who would believe your nonsense. "Ye Yuxuan thought silently in his heart, with deep disdain and contempt at the same time.
The feet were lifted higher, almost separated from the ground, and only the toes were still touching the ground. At this moment, a flash of inspiration flashed in Ye Yuxuan's mind, and he faintly felt that something was wrong.
By the way, I am now on the top of a tall building, and at this time, no one should come here, so how could someone's voice reach my ears. Driven by curiosity, he immediately leaned back and placed his heels on the ground.
He suddenly opened his eyes and glanced around, but there was no trace of him. Ye Yuxuan, who thought he was hallucinating, was just about to jump off the building again.那道声音又传了出来。
“请选择：确定与取消。 "
"Sure," Ye Yuxuan shouted loudly with great curiosity as he saw that there was no one around and wanted to know what the show was all about.
Suddenly, Ye Yuxuan fell into a coma. When he woke up again, he was in a vast room. Standing in front of him was a man with black wings, black hair, silver eyes, and two goat horns on his head. He looked at him with a smile that resembled the devil recorded in the book.
Welcome to the evil space, where you can get everything you want, as long as you can complete our mission and survive! My name is commentator No. 7654321. If you have any questions within my authority, I can help you answer them! ”解说员7654321号和蔼的笑着说道。
Seeing this creature that was obviously not of the same race as himself, Ye Yuxuan was shocked at first, and then slowly calmed down, because for a person who has no love in life, there is nothing that can scare him.
After a moment of silence, Ye Yuxuan looked at the commentator No. 7654321 and asked, "I want to know what to do if I want to resurrect my parents.
Commentator No. 7654321 saw this human being's calm reaction and asked slightly in surprise, "Aren't you surprised and scared when you see me? "
"Surprised, but for a person like me who is not even afraid of death, what can scare me! ”叶宇轩淡淡的说道。
Resurrection is possible, but this is a higher wish. With your current authorityCan't do it yet. If you want to know about your parents' ashes, join us and I can tell you now. Commentator No. 7654321 said with a cunning look in his eyes.
"I'll join." Upon hearing the word ashes, Ye Yuxuan's eyes dimmed again, then lit up, he frowned and thought for a moment, then said slowly.
The narrator suddenly knelt down and said to the endless darkness in the sky: "Lord Satan, please lower your magic light. Help our new members be baptized.
A jet-black light shot out from the endless darkness and penetrated directly into Ling Ye Yuxuan's eyebrows. Countless messages rang in his mind:
According to the rules of heaven and earth, the space of good and evil is established.
“Here are the basic rules of evil space. "The selected person will immediately enter the stand-alone game world or the online game world.
The chosen one who obtains the subordinate ring will be able to immediately pull 5 to 20 intelligent creatures into the evil space in the real world or the game world.
The strength of the chosen one who is forcibly pulled must be lower than that of the chosen one. In addition, the selected person must enter the space ten times and complete the tasks or get 1 million points before he can get a wish and return to the original world. Only the chosen ones can take the intelligent creatures they pulled in out of the evil space after entering the space and completing a mission!
When the chosen one goes on a space mission, all the chosen ones must also enter the evil space, otherwise they will be wiped out. No one is allowed to reveal the information of this space in the real world, otherwise they will be wiped out! "
The selected person must perform and complete the task within the time specified in the evil space. In addition, the space he enters each time is uncertain, so he can choose at will.
"After completing 10 space missions or paying 1 million points, both the chosen and the chosen ones can realize a wish! And they can completely leave this space and freely use the abilities obtained from the space!"
"Before you complete 10 space missions or pay 1 million points, you must ensure that no one knows about using the abilities obtained from this space in the real world. If someone knows and does not eliminate the person at a specific time, the selected person will be wiped out!"
"Do you want to be the chosen one? Choose: Yes. You will then experience the elimination mission of the chosen ones! The world you experience is the legendary world of passion in the game world! If you choose no, your memory will be erased and you will be returned to the real world!
Tip! This space is full of dangers, you have narrowly missed death and danced with the devil, but there is always a glimmer of life, so please choose to join carefully! Once you become the chosen one, complete the mission. You can learn about the ashes of your parents and get a certain amount of money that you need in reality.
Ye Yuxuan chose to confirm without any hesitation.
The chosen one (fake), number 666666, underwent a body scan, with strength 15 [10], agility 12 [10], spirit 8 [10], and physical strength 13 [10]. The qualities in brackets are those of an average 30-year-old adult man.
"Change your image? Beautify 1% - 100%! Ugly 1% to 100%, the appearance is completely changed, the race is shown as white, yellow, or black, and the gender is changed to male or female! Please choose! "
"The appearance has completely changed! The race is yellow and the gender is male! "
"Initialization begins! Entering the space for the first time, the space difficulty level is D, and the player is strengthened by 200%! Pain sensation reduced by 60%! There are still 20 seconds left before entering the legendary world of passion!
This world is a world of killing. Killing the chosen one (fake) like yourself can obtain the opponent's equipment, points, and props.
The trial begins: A wave of dizziness hits Ye Yuxuan, and he suddenly falls into endless darkness
